title: a16z Podcast: Addiction vs Popularity in the Age of Virality

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: In the age of virality, what does it actually mean to be popular?
reader_summary.overview: In the age of virality, what does it actually mean to be popular? When does popularity -- or good product design, for that matter -- cross over from desire and engagement... Journalist and editor Derek Thompson, author of Hit Makers: The Science of Popularity in an Age of Distraction -- and NYU professor Adam Alter, author of Irresistible.

key_points.text: Journalist and editor Derek Thompson, author of Hit Makers: The Science of Popularity in an Age of Distraction -- and NYU professor Adam Alter.
The discussion covers everything from the relationship between novelty and familiarity (we like what we know we like!
and want more of it!) to what makes a hit.
